title: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization
title_zh: 并行AI智能体协作作为图结构化分布式分块优化

paragraphs.en: Parallel AI agents can each produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. The graph certifies compatible sets of edits through its independent sets, and evaluating proposals against the same current solution yields verified gains that add exactly within any such set. A coordinator can therefore construct a safe compatible candidate while additionally evaluating interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that, using an optimal fractional coloring, the safe merger preserves a 1 / χ f ​ ( G ) 1/\chi_{f}(G) fraction of the total verified local improvement, where χ f ​ ( G ) \chi_{f}(G) is the fractional chromatic number of the dependency graph. We further show that no merger restricted to selecting a subset of the same proposals can guarantee a larger fraction in general. Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap, separating the effects of task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost. The resulting rate gives a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time–cost trade-off. We complement the analysis with experiments on solution quality and the cost of parallel coordination. Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail. On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost. On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs. For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.
paragraphs.zh: 并行的AI智能体各自都能产生有用的局部编辑，但当这些编辑被合并时却可能使共享的解退化。 我们将这一协调问题建模为具有可精确求值的目标函数和已知依赖图的离散块优化。 该图通过其独立集来认证兼容的编辑集合，而将提案针对同一个当前解进行求值可以得到经过验证的收益，这些收益在任何一个这样的集合内恰好可以相加。 因此，协调者可以在构建一个安全的兼容候选解的同时，额外评估相互作用的编辑以捕捉有利的交互。 我们证明，使用最优分数染色时，安全合并能够保留总验证局部改进的 1 / χ f ​ ( G ) 1/\chi_{f}(G) 比例，其中 χ f ​ ( G ) \chi_{f}(G) 是依赖图的分数色数。 我们进一步证明，一般而言，任何仅限于从相同提案中选择子集的合并都无法保证更大的比例。 在条件性局部改进保证和块误差界条件下，重复协作在目标差距上呈几何级数收敛，从而分离了任务结构、智能体分配和计算成本的影响。 所得的收敛率给出了一个用于智能体分配的线性规划以及一个显式的时间–成本权衡。 我们通过关于解的质量和并行协调成本的实验来补充这一分析。 代码修复实验表明，经过验证的合并能够解决单独有用但会导致朴素合并失败的编辑之间的冲突。 在更大的无冲突任务上，并行智能体能以更高的等效输入token成本降低建模的完成时间。 在三个公共路网上，分数整合在90次配对运行中保留了922个单位的经过验证的图割改进。 对于共享车辆路径独占访问权的路径搜索智能体，分数调度在十二次配对运行中将实测墙钟时间中位数降低了15%，路径成本的变化则因运行而异。

paragraphs.en: Many tasks handled by AI agents can be decomposed into components that are worked on in parallel. This can reduce latency and distribute work across components, but it also creates a coordination problem. An edit that improves one component in isolation may interact with edits to other components once they are combined. Program repair provides a concrete example: agents may modify different modules in parallel, yet their changes can still interfere through shared functionality or interfaces. The central question is therefore not only how to generate useful local edits, but also how to decide which of them can be safely integrated into the shared solution.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体处理的许多任务可以分解为可并行处理的组成部分。 这可以降低延迟并在各组成部分之间分摊工作，但也会带来协调问题。 一处孤立地改进某个组成部分的修改，一旦与其他修改合并，可能会相互影响。 程序修复提供了一个具体例子：智能体可以并行修改不同的模块，但它们的改动仍可能通过共享的功能或接口相互干扰。 因此，核心问题不仅在于如何生成有用的局部修改，还在于如何决定哪些修改可以安全地整合进共享的解决方案中。

sents.en: Many tasks handled by AI agents can be decomposed into components that are worked on in parallel.

sents.zh: 程序修复提供了一个具体例子：智能体可以并行修改不同的模块，但它们的改动仍可能通过共享的功能或接口相互干扰。

sents.en: The central question is therefore not only how to generate useful local edits, but also how to decide which of them can be safely integrated into the shared solution.
sents.zh: 因此，核心问题不仅在于如何生成有用的局部修改，还在于如何决定哪些修改可以安全地整合进共享的解决方案中。

paragraphs.en: For example, suppose a program must apply a discount exactly once, and either the pricing module or the checkout module can implement the required transformation. Starting from a version that does not apply the discount, an edit to either module improves the program on its own. If both edits are applied, however, the discount is applied twice. Thus, individually useful edits to different modules need not be compatible.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，假设某个程序必须恰好应用一次折扣，而定价模块或结账模块都可以实现所需的转换。 从一个不应用折扣的版本出发，对任一模块的修改本身都能改进该程序。 然而，如果同时应用这两处修改，折扣就会被应用两次。 因此，对不同模块各自有用的修改未必相互兼容。

paragraphs.en: The example exposes a broader coordination problem in parallel agent work. A proposed edit can be evaluated in isolation against the current artifact, yet its value may change when other edits are applied alongside it. We therefore separate proposal generation from proposal integration. Agents work concurrently from the same artifact on distinct blocks, while a coordinator uses an evaluator and dependency information to decide which returned edits to combine. Our goal is to determine how much of the verified local improvement can be guaranteed to be retained after integration.
paragraphs.zh: 该例子揭示了并行智能体工作中一个更广泛的协调问题。 一项提议的修改可以针对当前工件孤立地进行评估，但当它与其他修改一起应用时，其价值可能会发生变化。 因此，我们将提议的生成与提议的整合分离开来。 多个智能体基于同一工件并行处理不同的区块，而协调者利用评估器和依赖信息来决定合并哪些返回的修改。 我们的目标是确定在整合之后，经过验证的局部改进中有多少能够得到保证而被保留下来。

sents.en: The example exposes a broader coordination problem in parallel agent work.
sents.zh: 该例子揭示了并行智能体工作中一个更广泛的协调问题。

sents.en: A proposed edit can be evaluated in isolation against the current artifact, yet its value may change when other edits are applied alongside it.

sents.en: Our goal is to determine how much of the verified local improvement can be guaranteed to be retained after integration.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是确定在整合之后，经过验证的局部改进中有多少能够得到保证而被保留下来。

paragraphs.en: We call this problem verified proposal integration . The coordinator observes black-box block proposals, their verified singleton gains against a common base artifact, and a dependency certificate identifying subsets whose gains add exactly. It need not know how the proposals were generated or model their joint effects beyond this certificate. We ask how much of the verified local improvement a coordinator can always preserve using only this information. Our main result is a tight worst-case bound for integrating fixed proposals. We extend the analysis to convergence and agent allocation under additional assumptions. Experiments examine the integration mechanism and its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这个问题称为已验证提案整合。 协调者观察黑盒区块提案、它们相对于共同基础工件的已验证单体增益，以及一个依赖证书，该证书标识出哪些子集的增益恰好可相加。 协调者无需知道提案是如何生成的，也无需在此证书之外对它们的联合效应建模。 我们要问的是：仅凭这些信息，协调者究竟能够始终保留多少已验证的局部改进。 我们的主要结果是一个针对固定提案整合的紧致最坏情况界。 在附加假设下，我们将分析扩展到收敛性与智能体分配。 实验考察了该整合机制及其代价。

sents.en: Our main result is a tight worst-case bound for integrating fixed proposals.

sents.en: We extend the analysis to convergence and agent allocation under additional assumptions.

paragraphs.en: We formulate verified proposal integration for black-box agent edits and characterize its exact worst-case retention factor. Given verified singleton gains and a dependency certificate, a coordinator can always preserve a 1 / χ f ​ ( G ) 1/\chi_{f}(G) fraction of the total verified local improvement. This guarantee is tight: in the worst case, no coordinator that forms its update by selecting a subset of the submitted proposals can guarantee a larger fraction (Sections 2 – 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们为黑盒智能体编辑提出可验证提案整合的公式化表述，并刻画其精确的最坏情形保留因子。 给定已验证的单点增益和依赖性证书，协调者总能保留已验证局部改进总量的 1/\chi_{f}(G) 比例。 这一保证是紧的：在最坏情形下，任何通过从已提交提案中选择子集来构建更新的协调者，都无法保证更大的比例（第 2–3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Under explicit assumptions on agent capability, assignment coverage, and task structure, we establish geometric convergence of repeated verified integration. The convergence rate separates the effects of these three factors and yields a principled formulation for agent assignment and explicit time–cost trade-offs (Sections 4 – 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在对智能体能力、任务分配覆盖范围和任务结构做出明确假设的前提下，我们建立了反复验证式整合的几何收敛性。 该收敛速度将这三个因素的影响分离开来，并为智能体分配以及显式的时间–成本权衡提供了有原则的公式化表述（第 4 – 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: We test proposal integration and its costs with language-model agents and use controlled examples to clarify the guarantees. The experiments examine conflict resolution among individually useful edits, performance on held-out multi-round tasks, and the time–cost trade-off of parallel execution. A road-network diagnostic evaluates exact-factor merging on naturally occurring block interactions and compares fractional integration with fixed and adaptive ordinary coloring (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们用语言模型智能体来测试提案的整合及其开销，并通过受控示例来阐明相关保证。 实验考察了对各自有用但相互冲突的编辑之间的冲突消解、在留出的多轮任务上的表现，以及并行执行的时间—开销权衡。 一个路网诊断任务在自然出现的块交互上评估精确因子合并，并将分数整合与固定的和自适应的普通着色进行比较（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our formulation builds on ideas from parallel and distributed optimization, where multiple components are updated concurrently while accounting for their interactions. In particular, it is closely related to parallel block coordinate descent and arbitrary sampling, which study how subsets of coordinates can be updated simultaneously ( Richtárik and Takáč, 2016 ; Qu and Richtárik, 2016 ) . Within this line of work, Bradley et al. (2011) analyze interference among parallel coordinate updates using a spectral measure. A complementary perspective appears in GenCD, which separates coordinate descent into selection, proposal, acceptance, and update stages and includes a coloring-based variant ( Scherrer et al., 2012 ) . Our setting differs in two important ways. First, proposals may be arbitrary discrete edits rather than gradient-based coordinate updates. Second, the coordinator observes verified singleton gains and a dependency certificate without requiring a smooth model of their joint effects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的构建方法借鉴了并行与分布式优化的思想，即多个组件在并发更新的同时考虑它们之间的相互作用。 具体而言，它与并行块坐标下降和任意采样密切相关，后者研究如何同时更新坐标的子集（ Richtárik and Takáč, 2016 ; Qu and Richtárik, 2016 ）。 在这一研究路线中，Bradley et al. （2011）使用谱度量分析了并行坐标更新之间的干扰。 一个互补的视角出现在 GenCD 中，它将坐标下降分为选择、提议、接受和更新四个阶段，并包含一种基于着色的变体（ Scherrer et al., 2012 ）。 我们的设定在两个重要方面有所不同。 首先，提议可以是任意的离散编辑，而不是基于梯度的坐标更新。 其次，协调器观察到的是经验证的单点收益和依赖性证书，而无需对其联合效应建立光滑模型。

sents.en: Our formulation builds on ideas from parallel and distributed optimization, where multiple components are updated concurrently while accounting for their interactions.
sents.zh: 我们的构建方法借鉴了并行与分布式优化的思想，即多个组件在并发更新的同时考虑它们之间的相互作用。

sents.en: A complementary perspective appears in GenCD, which separates coordinate descent into selection, proposal, acceptance, and update stages and includes a coloring-based variant ( Scherrer et al., 2012 ) .

sents.en: Our setting differs in two important ways.
sents.zh: 我们的设定在两个重要方面有所不同。

sents.en: First, proposals may be arbitrary discrete edits rather than gradient-based coordinate updates.
sents.zh: 首先，提议可以是任意的离散编辑，而不是基于梯度的坐标更新。

sents.en: Second, the coordinator observes verified singleton gains and a dependency certificate without requiring a smooth model of their joint effects.
sents.zh: 其次，协调器观察到的是经验证的单点收益和依赖性证书，而无需对其联合效应建立光滑模型。

paragraphs.en: Distributed constraint optimization (DCOP) coordinates agents that control different variables to optimize a shared objective expressed through local functions ( Modi et al., 2005 ; Fioretto et al., 2018 ; Troullinos et al., 2025 ) . This is closely related in spirit to our use of localized dependencies, but the coordination problem is different. In DCOP, agents coordinate the choice of variable assignments themselves. In our setting, agents have already generated candidate edits, and the coordinator decides which submitted proposals to combine using their verified singleton gains and a dependency certificate. Our focus is therefore on verified integration of independently generated proposals rather than distributed search over the solution space.
paragraphs.zh: 分布式约束优化（DCOP）协调控制不同变量的智能体，以优化通过局部函数表达的共享目标（Modi et al., 2005; Fioretto et al., 2018; Troullinos et al., 2025）。 这在精神上与我们使用局部化依赖的方式密切相关，但协调问题有所不同。 在 DCOP 中，智能体自行协调变量赋值的选择。 在我们的设定中，智能体已经生成了候选编辑，协调者依据已验证的单项收益和依赖证书来决定合并哪些已提交的提案。 因此，我们的重点在于对独立生成的提案进行经验证的整合，而不是在解空间上进行分布式搜索。

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents have increasingly been applied to software development and repair. MetaGPT and ChatDev organize software development through structured roles and multi-agent collaboration ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . MAGIS and MASAI decompose repository-level software tasks across specialized agents ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Arora et al., 2024 ) . RepairAgent instead focuses on autonomous program repair through tool use and iterative validation ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) , while a recent survey reviews the broader use of multi-agent systems across the software-development lifecycle ( He et al., 2025 ) . These works focus primarily on how software agents generate, coordinate, and refine solutions. We instead isolate the integration step, where independently generated edits must be reconciled into a single shared artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体已被越来越多地应用于软件开发与修复。 MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 通过结构化角色与多智能体协作来组织软件开发（Hong et al., 2024; Qian et al., 2024）。 MAGIS 和 MASAI 将仓库级软件任务分解给专门的智能体（Tao et al., 2024; Arora et al., 2024）。 RepairAgent 则专注于通过工具使用和迭代验证实现自主程序修复（Bouzenia et al., 2025），同时一篇近期综述回顾了多智能体系统在软件开发生命周期中更广泛的应用（He et al., 2025）。 这些工作主要关注软件智能体如何生成、协调和改进解决方案。 我们则聚焦于集成步骤，即必须将独立生成的编辑调和为单一共享制品的过程。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work studies how collaboration structures among agents should be designed or adapted. GPTSwarm represents agent systems as optimizable computational graphs ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , while DyLAN dynamically selects agents and communication structures ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Hyperagent uses hypergraphs for the topology of multi-agent communication ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These methods focus on structuring how agents interact during problem solving. By contrast, our dependency graph represents interactions among components of the shared artifact rather than communication links among agents. It identifies subsets of proposed edits whose verified gains add exactly and thereby supports their certified integration.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条独立的研究路线探讨智能体之间的协作结构应如何设计或调整。 GPTSwarm 将智能体系统表示为可优化的计算图（Zhuge et al., 2024），而 DyLAN 则动态选择智能体和通信结构（Liu et al., 2024）。 Hyperagent 使用超图作为多智能体通信的拓扑结构（Zhang et al., 2026）。 这些方法关注的是在问题求解过程中如何组织智能体之间的交互。 与之相比，我们的依赖图表示的是共享工件各组件之间的交互，而非智能体之间的通信链接。 它能够识别出那些经验证的收益可以精确相加的编辑提议子集，从而支持将它们经过认证后进行集成。

paragraphs.en: We refer to the known factor scopes, or any graph that conservatively encodes them, as a dependency certificate . Such a certificate ensures that blocks in the same independent set do not affect a common objective factor. In program repair, it may be obtained from declared test–module scopes, interface dependencies, or conservative static analysis. What matters is shared dependence in the objective rather than physical overlap between the edited components. Adding extra edges to G G preserves the validity of the certificate but may weaken the resulting guarantee. Omitting a true dependency, however, may incorrectly classify interacting edits as compatible.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将已知的因子作用域，或任何保守地编码这些作用域的图，称为依赖证书。 这样的证书可确保同一独立集中的代码块不会影响共同的目标因子。 在程序修复中，它可以从声明的测试模块作用域、接口依赖或保守的静态分析中获得。 重要的是在目标中的共享依赖，而非被编辑组件之间的物理重叠。 向图 G 中添加额外的边会保持证书的有效性，但可能削弱所得的保证。 然而，遗漏一个真实的依赖，可能会错误地将相互作用的编辑归类为兼容的编辑。

paragraphs.en: The per-round integration guarantee depends only on the verified singleton gains and the dependency structure. To obtain a global convergence rate, we introduce three additional ingredients: local solver quality, a block error bound, and assignment coverage. We then combine these factors with the integration guarantee to obtain the contraction rate.

paragraphs.en: We examine whether verified integration resolves conflicts among local repairs, when parallel work offsets its coordination cost, and whether fractional coloring retains more gain from the same proposals. The four repair benchmarks use Python tasks with declared module dependencies and an objective F F that counts failed checks. Agents see the specification, current code, and visible checks. The coordinator uses visible and hidden checks to determine acceptance and stopping. A run is successful when its final artifact passes all checks. We also examine proposal integration on public road networks and course-timetabling instances, and the scheduling of parallel route searches on vehicle-routing instances.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考察经验证的集成能否解决局部修复之间的冲突，并行工作是否能抵消其协调成本，以及分数着色能否从相同的提案中保留更多收益。 四个修复基准使用带有已声明模块依赖关系的 Python 任务，其目标函数 F F 统计失败的检查项数量。 智能体可以看到规范说明、当前代码以及可见的检查项。 协调器使用可见和隐藏的检查项来判定接受与停止。 当一次运行的最终产物通过所有检查项时，该次运行即为成功。 我们还考察了提案集成在公共道路网络和课程排课实例上的表现，以及并行路径搜索在车辆路径规划实例上的调度情况。

sents.zh: 当一次运行的最终产物通过所有检查项时，该次运行即为成功。

sents.en: We also examine proposal integration on public road networks and course-timetabling instances, and the scheduling of parallel route searches on vehicle-routing instances.
sents.zh: 我们还考察了提案集成在公共道路网络和课程排课实例上的表现，以及并行路径搜索在车辆路径规划实例上的调度情况。

paragraphs.en: For the conflict and scale benchmarks, we compare safe color-class integration ( COL ) and optimistic integration ( OPT ) with four baselines. MA applies all parallel proposals, while MAG accepts their union only when it lowers F F . SGL assigns the whole program to one agent, and SEQ visits modules sequentially. Both baselines accept only improving edits. All protocols start from the same faulty artifact. Each call starts with a fresh context, and only edits to its assigned modules are kept. The parallel rules share first-round proposals and subsequently work from their own accepted artifacts. Appendix A provides further experimental details.
paragraphs.zh: 对于冲突和规模基准，我们将安全颜色类整合（COL）与乐观整合（OPT）同四个基线进行比较。 MA 应用所有并行提案，而 MAG 仅在降低 F F 时才接受它们的并集。 SGL 将整个程序分配给一个智能体，而 SEQ 依次访问各个模块。 两种基线都只接受有改进的编辑。 所有协议都从同一个有缺陷的制品出发。 每次调用都以全新的上下文开始，且只保留对其所分配模块的编辑。 并行规则共享第一轮提案，随后各自基于自己已接受的制品继续工作。 附录 A 提供了进一步的实验细节。

paragraphs.en: We report input-token-equivalent cost, which weights ordinary input, cache-write, and cache-read tokens and excludes output tokens. For modeled completion time, each round contributes the duration of its slowest agent call, together with an assumed verification latency t ver t_{\mathrm{ver}} for each verification stage that must complete before the procedure can continue. Checks performed in parallel within the same stage incur this latency only once. Agent calls within a round are assumed to start simultaneously. The accounting formula and sensitivity to t ver t_{\mathrm{ver}} are given in Appendices A – C .

paragraphs.en: The first benchmark contains seven three-module tasks whose dependency graphs are paths, with χ f ​ ( G ) = χ ⁡ ( G ) = 2 \chi_{f}(G)=\chi(G)=2 . In six tasks, either of two adjacent modules can perform a required transformation, but applying it twice causes an error. The seventh task states interface ownership explicitly. We run three replicates per task with claude-haiku-4-5 and one replicate with claude-sonnet-5 , giving 21 and seven task–replicate units, respectively. To diagnose a conflict, we test the two adjacent proposals while keeping the remaining module fixed to a known-good implementation. We classify the two proposals as conflicting when each passes the interface check individually, but applying both together causes the check to fail.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that both verified rules, COL and OPT , solve all 28 task–replicate units. MA solves all 17 units without a first-round conflict but none of the 11 conflict units, while MAG recovers only one of these conflicts. Task T1 illustrates this failure mode. Under MA , the two agents repeatedly add or remove the same transformation, producing a failure-count trajectory of 21 , 5 , 5 , 5 21,5,5,5 . OPT verifies the removals separately and accepts one, leaving a single copy of the transformation and reducing the trajectory to 21 , 5 , 0 21,5,0 . Across both models, OPT selected the color candidate in 11 of 37 union evaluations, and all 108 audited color merges satisfied the additivity condition.

With Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct , we compare the four parallel rules above with safe fractional integration ( FRAC ) and its optimistic variant ( FOPT ). All six rules receive the same first-round proposals and then continue from their own accepted programs for at most three rounds.

paragraphs.en: Fractional coloring retains more gain than ordinary coloring on 30 of the 48 first-round proposal sets. The difference is smaller at termination: FRAC and COL leave means of 6.17 and 6.19 failed checks. Later proposals depend on the program accepted by each rule, so the initial advantage need not persist through subsequent rounds. A single agent restricted to one module per call leaves a mean of 12.27 failed checks; allowing multi-file edits and up to twice FOPT ’s token use gives 20.52, with frequent output-parsing failures. Appendix E gives the control protocols, resource accounting, and results by graph family.

paragraphs.en: We test the merger mechanism on factors taken directly from three public road networks ( SNAP, 2026 ) . A deterministic, proposal-blind structural screen selected 30 nonoverlapping held-out regions, ten per network, each containing five connected blocks of 32 road vertices whose actual interblock roads form an induced C 5 C_{5} . Three fixed initial-label seeds per region yield 90 paired region–seed units. Each road edge touching a selected block contributes one factor to a binary graph-cut objective. Five separate CPU agents each make 30,000 balanced-swap attempts within one block. A common guarded-union warm start precedes the comparison. All integration rules then score the same five fresh, individually verified proposals from the same incumbent. Appendix G gives the frozen screen and protocol.

sents.en: We test the merger mechanism on factors taken directly from three public road networks ( SNAP, 2026 ) .

sents.en: A deterministic, proposal-blind structural screen selected 30 nonoverlapping held-out regions, ten per network, each containing five connected blocks of 32 road vertices whose actual interblock roads form an induced C 5 C_{5} .

sents.zh: 每个区域三个固定的初始标签种子，共得到 90 个配对的区域–种子单元。

sents.en: Each road edge touching a selected block contributes one factor to a binary graph-cut objective.
sents.zh: 每条触及所选块的道路边都为二元图割目标贡献一个因子。

paragraphs.en: The fractional-support rule retains 922 of 1,617 verified singleton-gain units (57.0%), compared with 799 (49.4%) for the pre-fixed ordinary coloring, a 15.4% relative increase (Table 3 ). It is strictly better in 52 of 90 paired runs and ties in the rest; no loss is possible here by construction because its support dominates the pre-fixed color classes for nonnegative gains. The three-seed region means favor it in 28 of 30 regions and tie in two. Unguarded full union increases the graph-cut objective in 31 runs despite every nonnull proposal improving the common incumbent alone.
paragraphs.zh: 分数支持规则在1,617个经验证的单例增益单元中保留了922个（57.0%），而预先固定的普通着色为799个（49.4%），相对提升15.4%（表3）。 在90组配对运行中，它在52组中严格更优，其余打成平手；根据构造，这里不可能出现损失，因为其支持集在非负增益下支配预先固定的颜色类。 三种子区域均值在30个区域中有28个偏向于它，其余两个打成平手。 尽管每个非空提议单独都能改进共同 incumbents 解，无守护完全并集仍在31次运行中提升了图割目标值。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive ordinary coloring, chosen after observing singleton gains, can include the highest-gain independent pair and also retains 922 units across all 90 runs. paragraphs.en: We evaluate verified integration on nine ITC-2007 timetabling instances ( Di Gaspero et al., 2007 ) , selected for induced C 5 C_{5} course subgraphs before proposal generation. Five computational agents independently change lecture periods for separate courses from a common timetable, keeping rooms fixed; dependencies follow shared teachers, curricula, or fixed rooms. On identical proposals, FRAC retains 10% more improvement than fixed COL , winning on two instances and tying on seven (Table 4 ). All 45 compatible-pair merges satisfy exact additivity, and the selected compatible updates pass the official validator. MA creates a room conflict on comp13 ; adaptive ordinary coloring matches FRAC .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在九个 ITC-2007 排课实例（Di Gaspero et al., 2007）上评估了经验证的集成方法，这些实例因其在提案生成前所诱导的 C 5 C_{5} 课程子图而被选中。 五个计算智能体基于同一份课表，独立地为各自不同的课程更改授课时段，同时保持教室固定；依赖关系来自共享的教师、课程体系或固定教室。 在相同的提案下，FRAC 比固定 COL 多保留 10% 的改进量，在两个实例上获胜，在七个实例上打平（表 4）。 全部 45 个兼容对合并均满足精确可加性，且被选中的兼容更新通过了官方验证器。 MA 在 comp13 上产生了一个教室冲突；自适应普通着色与 FRAC 相当。

paragraphs.en: We test a different use of fractional coloring: scheduling preemptible search by agents that hold exclusive locks on their assigned pairs of vehicle routes. On each of four public instances of the capacitated vehicle-routing problem (CVRP), five stochastic local-search agents are assigned consecutive pairs of routes, deliberately inducing a C 5 C_{5} conflict graph. Nonadjacent agents can search concurrently on two CPU workers. Both schedules allocate exactly 500,000 candidate-move evaluations to every agent. A fixed ordinary coloring executes the compatible groups ( 0 , 2 ) (0,2) , ( 1 , 3 ) (1,3) , ( 4 ) (4) in three full-budget waves; a fractional cover executes ( 0 , 2 ) (0,2) , ( 1 , 3 ) (1,3) , ( 2 , 4 ) (2,4) , ( 3 , 0 ) (3,0) , ( 4 , 1 ) (4,1) in five half-budget waves. Thus χ ⁡ ( C 5 ) = 3 \chi(C_{5})=3 and χ f ​ ( C 5 ) = 5 / 2 \chi_{f}(C_{5})=5/2 predict a shorter critical path under this locking and preemption model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试分数染色的另一种用途：对在其被分配的车辆路线对上持有独占锁的智能体进行可抢占搜索的调度。 在四个容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）的公开实例中的每一个上，五个随机局部搜索智能体被分配到连续的路线对，刻意构造出 C 5 C_{5} 冲突图。 非相邻的智能体可以在两个 CPU 工作线程上并发搜索。 两种调度方案都为每个智能体精确分配 500,000 次候选移动评估。 固定普通染色分三个满预算波次执行相容组 ( 0 , 2 ) (0,2) 、 ( 1 , 3 ) (1,3) 、 ( 4 ) (4)；分数覆盖分五个半预算波次执行 ( 0 , 2 ) (0,2) 、 ( 1 , 3 ) (1,3) 、 ( 2 , 4 ) (2,4) 、 ( 3 , 0 ) (3,0) 、 ( 4 , 1 ) (4,1)。 因此，在这种锁定与抢占模型下，χ ⁡ ( C 5 ) = 3 \chi(C_{5})=3 和 χ f ​ ( C 5 ) = 5 / 2 \chi_{f}(C_{5})=5/2 预示着更短的关键路径。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports measured wall time, rather than the modeled latency used in the repair scaling benchmark. Across the twelve pairs, fractional scheduling is faster by 13.16–17.28%; the median reduction is 15.00%. Summed agent CPU time is nearly unchanged (fractional/integral median ratio 1.008). All 24 final route sets satisfy capacity and customer-coverage constraints, but route cost is better under the fractional schedule in only four pairs, tied in five, and worse in three. Appendix H gives the full paired times and route-cost differences.

paragraphs.en: We formulate parallel agent collaboration as verified proposal integration. Evaluating proposals against a common artifact yields local gains, while the dependency graph identifies compatible sets whose gains add exactly. Fractional coloring gives the tight worst-case retention factor 1 / χ f ​ ( G ) 1/\chi_{f}(G) , and evaluating the full union allows the coordinator to capture favorable interactions. Under the local-improvement and block error-bound assumptions, repeated integration converges geometrically. The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and proposal integration, providing a basis for choosing assignments and balancing progress against time and cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将并行智能体协作表述为经过验证的提案集成。 针对同一工件对提案进行评估可带来局部增益，而依赖图可识别出兼容集合，其增益恰好可以相加。 分数染色给出了紧的最坏情形保留因子 1 / χ f ​ ( G ) 1/\chi_{f}(G)，而评估完整并集使协调者能够捕捉有利的交互。 在局部改进与分块误差界的假设下，反复集成几何级收敛。 该速率区分了任务结构、智能体分配与提案集成，为选择分配方案以及在进度与时间、成本之间进行权衡提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: The experiments show how compatibility shapes both the quality and cost of parallel work. Selecting compatible proposals resolves conflicts between individually useful repairs and improves retained gain over a fixed coloring on road-network objectives. Adaptive ordinary coloring matches the latter result, linking the improvement to the compatible sets considered. Parallel execution reduces modeled completion time on larger compatible repair tasks at higher input cost, while fractional scheduling shortens measured route-search time under exclusive route access. These results connect the integration of local edits and the scheduling of parallel work through their shared dependency structure.
paragraphs.zh: 实验展示了兼容性如何同时影响并行工作的质量与成本。 选择兼容的提案能够解决各自有用但相互冲突的修复之间的冲突，并提高在固定着色方案下于道路网络目标上保留的收益。 自适应普通着色得到了与后者一致的结果，将这一改进与所考虑的兼容集合联系起来。 在更大的兼容修复任务上，并行执行以更高的输入成本降低了建模的完成时间，而分数调度则在独占路径访问条件下缩短了实测的路径搜索时间。 这些结果通过共享的依赖结构，将局部编辑的集成与并行工作的调度联系起来。

sents.zh: 我们使用 OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex 和 Anthropic Claude 来讨论数学论证与实验设计、实现实验、核查文献并编辑稿件。

sents.zh: 作者审阅了 AI 辅助生成的内容，核对了证明与引用，并验证了所报告的实验结果。

paragraphs.en: The seven tasks contain 26–35 checks and 9–49 lines of faulty editable code each, with 207 checks in total. Each task provides a specification, three faulty modules, and 13–19 lines of fixed code connecting them. Unit checks involve one module, while integration checks involve two adjacent modules. Each factor ℓ a \ell_{a} in ( 2 ) indicates whether one visible or hidden check fails.
paragraphs.zh: 这七个任务每个包含 26–35 项检查和 9–49 行有错误的可编辑代码，共计 207 项检查。 每个任务提供一份规范说明、三个有错误的模块，以及连接它们的 13–19 行固定代码。 单元检查只涉及一个模块，而集成检查则涉及两个相邻的模块。 式 ( 2 ) 中的每个因子 ℓ a \ell_{a} 表示某一项可见或隐藏的检查是否失败。

sents.en: The seven tasks contain 26–35 checks and 9–49 lines of faulty editable code each, with 207 checks in total.
sents.zh: 这七个任务每个包含 26–35 项检查和 9–49 行有错误的可编辑代码，共计 207 项检查。

sents.en: Each task provides a specification, three faulty modules, and 13–19 lines of fixed code connecting them.
sents.zh: 每个任务提供一份规范说明、三个有错误的模块，以及连接它们的 13–19 行固定代码。

sents.en: Unit checks involve one module, while integration checks involve two adjacent modules.
sents.zh: 单元检查只涉及一个模块，而集成检查则涉及两个相邻的模块。

sents.en: Each factor ℓ a \ell_{a} in ( 2 ) indicates whether one visible or hidden check fails.
sents.zh: 式 ( 2 ) 中的每个因子 ℓ a \ell_{a} 表示某一项可见或隐藏的检查是否失败。

paragraphs.en: In T1–T6, either of two adjacent modules can perform the required interface transformation. We verified that assigning the transformation to either module gives a solution with F = 0 F=0 , whereas applying it in both modules produces the integration failures reported in Table 6 . We also checked the initial failure counts and traced the module calls made by each check against its declared dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 在 T1–T6 中，两个相邻模块中的任意一个都可以执行所需的接口转换。 我们验证了将转换分配给任一模块都能得到 F = 0 的解，而在两个模块中都应用该转换则会产生表 6 中报告的集成失败。 我们还检查了初始失败计数，并针对每个检查所声明的依赖追踪了其调用的模块。

sents.en: In T1–T6, either of two adjacent modules can perform the required interface transformation.
sents.zh: 在 T1–T6 中，两个相邻模块中的任意一个都可以执行所需的接口转换。

sents.en: We verified that assigning the transformation to either module gives a solution with F = 0 F=0 , whereas applying it in both modules produces the integration failures reported in Table 6 .
sents.zh: 我们验证了将转换分配给任一模块都能得到 F = 0 的解，而在两个模块中都应用该转换则会产生表 6 中报告的集成失败。

sents.en: We also checked the initial failure counts and traced the module calls made by each check against its declared dependencies.
sents.zh: 我们还检查了初始失败计数，并针对每个检查所声明的依赖追踪了其调用的模块。

paragraphs.en: Agents can run the visible checks during repair. The coordinator evaluates both visible and hidden checks when accepting edits and stops a successful run when all checks pass.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以在修复过程中运行可见的检查。 协调器在接受编辑时会同时评估可见和隐藏的检查，并在所有检查通过时停止成功的运行。

sents.en: Agents can run the visible checks during repair.
sents.zh: 智能体可以在修复过程中运行可见的检查。

sents.en: The coordinator evaluates both visible and hidden checks when accepting edits and stops a successful run when all checks pass.
sents.zh: 协调器在接受编辑时会同时评估可见和隐藏的检查，并在所有检查通过时停止成功的运行。

paragraphs.en: The main comparison uses claude-haiku-4-5 , with three replicates per task, 21 task–replicate units, and 261 agent calls. The replication uses claude-sonnet-5 , with one replicate per task, seven units, and 74 calls. Each call starts with a fresh context and a separate copy of the current program. The instructions specify the task, the assigned module, and the available tests.
paragraphs.zh: 主要对比使用 claude-haiku-4-5，每个任务三次重复，共 21 个任务—重复单元，以及 261 次智能体调用。 复现实验使用 claude-sonnet-5，每个任务一次重复，共七个单元，以及 74 次调用。 每次调用都从全新的上下文和当前程序的一个独立副本开始。 指令中说明了任务、所分配的模块以及可用的测试。

sents.en: The main comparison uses claude-haiku-4-5 , with three replicates per task, 21 task–replicate units, and 261 agent calls.
sents.zh: 主要对比使用 claude-haiku-4-5，每个任务三次重复，共 21 个任务—重复单元，以及 261 次智能体调用。

sents.en: The replication uses claude-sonnet-5 , with one replicate per task, seven units, and 74 calls.
sents.zh: 复现实验使用 claude-sonnet-5，每个任务一次重复，共七个单元，以及 74 次调用。

sents.en: Each call starts with a fresh context and a separate copy of the current program.
sents.zh: 每次调用都从全新的上下文和当前程序的一个独立副本开始。

sents.en: The instructions specify the task, the assigned module, and the available tests.
sents.zh: 指令中说明了任务、所分配的模块以及可用的测试。

paragraphs.en: A module agent can inspect the starting program but may edit only its assigned module. Agents working in parallel receive the same starting program and cannot see one another’s edits during the round. Each agent can run the visible unit and integration checks involving its module and is told that evaluation will also use hidden checks of the same kinds. Only changes to the assigned module enter the proposal used by the coordinator. The single-agent baseline receives the same task specification, with permission to edit all three modules and run all visible checks.
paragraphs.zh: 模块智能体可以查看起始程序，但只能编辑其被分配的模块。 并行工作的智能体接收到相同的起始程序，并且在轮次期间无法看到彼此的修改。 每个智能体可以运行涉及其模块的可见单元测试和集成测试，并被告知评估还将使用同类隐藏测试。 只有对被分配模块的更改才会进入协调员使用的提案中。 单智能体基线接收相同的任务规范，并有权编辑所有三个模块和运行所有可见测试。

sents.en: A module agent can inspect the starting program but may edit only its assigned module.
sents.zh: 模块智能体可以查看起始程序，但只能编辑其被分配的模块。

sents.en: Agents working in parallel receive the same starting program and cannot see one another’s edits during the round.
sents.zh: 并行工作的智能体接收到相同的起始程序，并且在轮次期间无法看到彼此的修改。

sents.en: Each agent can run the visible unit and integration checks involving its module and is told that evaluation will also use hidden checks of the same kinds.
sents.zh: 每个智能体可以运行涉及其模块的可见单元测试和集成测试，并被告知评估还将使用同类隐藏测试。

sents.en: Only changes to the assigned module enter the proposal used by the coordinator.
sents.zh: 只有对被分配模块的更改才会进入协调员使用的提案中。

sents.en: The single-agent baseline receives the same task specification, with permission to edit all three modules and run all visible checks.
sents.zh: 单智能体基线接收相同的任务规范，并有权编辑所有三个模块和运行所有可见测试。

paragraphs.en: All protocols stop when F = 0 F=0 or when they reach their prescribed limit. SGL allows up to four whole-program repair sessions, each starting from the most recently accepted program. SEQ allows two passes through the modules in a fixed order and skips a module when all checks involving it already pass. Both baselines accept an edit only when it reduces F F .
paragraphs.zh: 所有协议在 F=0 时或达到其规定上限时停止。 SGL 允许最多四次整个程序的修复会话，每次都从最近被接受的程序开始。 SEQ 允许按固定顺序对模块进行两轮遍历，并且当涉及某模块的所有检查均已通过时跳过该模块。 两种基线方法都只有在编辑能降低 F 时才会接受该编辑。

sents.en: All protocols stop when F = 0 F=0 or when they reach their prescribed limit.
sents.zh: 所有协议在 F=0 时或达到其规定上限时停止。

sents.en: SGL allows up to four whole-program repair sessions, each starting from the most recently accepted program.
sents.zh: SGL 允许最多四次整个程序的修复会话，每次都从最近被接受的程序开始。

sents.en: SEQ allows two passes through the modules in a fixed order and skips a module when all checks involving it already pass.
sents.zh: SEQ 允许按固定顺序对模块进行两轮遍历，并且当涉及某模块的所有检查均已通过时跳过该模块。

sents.en: Both baselines accept an edit only when it reduces F F .
sents.zh: 两种基线方法都只有在编辑能降低 F 时才会接受该编辑。

paragraphs.en: The four parallel protocols allow up to three rounds. Each round assigns one agent to every module involved in a failing check, with all agents starting from the same program. The protocols share their first-round proposals, allowing a paired comparison of their merge decisions, and each protocol is charged for the calls it uses. Later rounds generate fresh proposals from each protocol’s own accepted program.
paragraphs.zh: 四个并行协议最多允许进行三轮。 每一轮为每个未通过检查所涉及的模块分配一个智能体，且所有智能体都从同一个程序出发。 各协议共享其第一轮的提案，从而可以对其合并决策进行成对比较，并且每个协议按其使用的调用次数计费。 后续轮次从各协议自己已接受的程序出发生成新的提案。

sents.en: The four parallel protocols allow up to three rounds.
sents.zh: 四个并行协议最多允许进行三轮。

sents.en: Each round assigns one agent to every module involved in a failing check, with all agents starting from the same program.
sents.zh: 每一轮为每个未通过检查所涉及的模块分配一个智能体，且所有智能体都从同一个程序出发。

sents.en: The protocols share their first-round proposals, allowing a paired comparison of their merge decisions, and each protocol is charged for the calls it uses.
sents.zh: 各协议共享其第一轮的提案，从而可以对其合并决策进行成对比较，并且每个协议按其使用的调用次数计费。

sents.en: Later rounds generate fresh proposals from each protocol’s own accepted program.
sents.zh: 后续轮次从各协议自己已接受的程序出发生成新的提案。

paragraphs.en: The parallel protocols differ in how they combine those proposals. MA applies their union directly, while MAG accepts the union only when it reduces F F . COL evaluates each changed module separately against the starting program, retains strictly improving proposals, and selects the color class with the largest summed gain, as in ( 6 ). OPT also evaluates the union of the retained proposals and selects it when its gain exceeds that of the color candidate ( 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些并行协议在如何组合那些提案上有所不同。 MA 直接应用它们的并集，而 MAG 仅当该并集能降低 F F 时才接受它。 COL 如 (6) 所示，针对起始程序分别评估每个发生变化的模块，保留严格带来改进的提案，并选择总增益最大的颜色类。 OPT 同样评估被保留提案的并集，并在其增益超过颜色候选者 (13) 的增益时选择该并集。

sents.en: The parallel protocols differ in how they combine those proposals.
sents.zh: 这些并行协议在如何组合那些提案上有所不同。

sents.en: MA applies their union directly, while MAG accepts the union only when it reduces F F .
sents.zh: MA 直接应用它们的并集，而 MAG 仅当该并集能降低 F F 时才接受它。

sents.en: COL evaluates each changed module separately against the starting program, retains strictly improving proposals, and selects the color class with the largest summed gain, as in ( 6 ).
sents.zh: COL 如 (6) 所示，针对起始程序分别评估每个发生变化的模块，保留严格带来改进的提案，并选择总增益最大的颜色类。

sents.en: OPT also evaluates the union of the retained proposals and selects it when its gain exceeds that of the color candidate ( 13 ).
sents.zh: OPT 同样评估被保留提案的并集，并在其增益超过颜色候选者 (13) 的增益时选择该并集。

paragraphs.en: After a color-class merge, verified proposals from the other class are retained and evaluated against the updated program before the next agent round. This permits further progress without requesting the same edit again. Together with skipping modules whose checks pass, reuse makes the assignment of work depend on the current program. The pointwise merge guarantee applies when the proposals satisfy Assumption 1 ; the convergence rate in Theorem 1 additionally requires its fixed conditional assignment distribution and uniform local-improvement bounds. The reported costs include the savings from proposal reuse as well as the cost of verification.
paragraphs.zh: 颜色类合并后，来自另一类的已验证提案会被保留，并在下一轮智能体回合之前针对更新后的程序进行评估。 这使得无需再次请求相同的编辑即可取得进一步进展。 加上跳过检查通过的模块，复用使工作分配依赖于当前程序。 逐点合并保证在提案满足假设 1 时适用；定理 1 中的收敛速度还额外要求其固定的条件分配分布和一致局部改进界。 报告的成本包括提案复用带来的节省以及验证的成本。

sents.en: After a color-class merge, verified proposals from the other class are retained and evaluated against the updated program before the next agent round.
sents.zh: 颜色类合并后，来自另一类的已验证提案会被保留，并在下一轮智能体回合之前针对更新后的程序进行评估。

sents.en: This permits further progress without requesting the same edit again.
sents.zh: 这使得无需再次请求相同的编辑即可取得进一步进展。

sents.en: Together with skipping modules whose checks pass, reuse makes the assignment of work depend on the current program.
sents.zh: 加上跳过检查通过的模块，复用使工作分配依赖于当前程序。

sents.en: The pointwise merge guarantee applies when the proposals satisfy Assumption 1 ; the convergence rate in Theorem 1 additionally requires its fixed conditional assignment distribution and uniform local-improvement bounds.
sents.zh: 逐点合并保证在提案满足假设 1 时适用；定理 1 中的收敛速度还额外要求其固定的条件分配分布和一致局部改进界。

sents.en: The reported costs include the savings from proposal reuse as well as the cost of verification.
sents.zh: 报告的成本包括提案复用带来的节省以及验证的成本。

paragraphs.en: We measure input-token-equivalent cost as input tokens + 1.25 × +\,1.25\times cache-write tokens + 0.1 × +\,0.1\times cache-read tokens. This measure excludes output tokens. One budget unit is the median call cost: 109,679 input-token equivalents for claude-haiku-4-5 and 75,441 for claude-sonnet-5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将输入令牌等价成本定义为：输入令牌 + 1.25 × +\,1.25\times 缓存写入令牌 + 0.1 × +\,0.1\times 缓存读取令牌。 该度量不包含输出令牌。 一个预算单位即一次调用的中位数成本：claude-haiku-4-5 为 109,679 个输入令牌等价量，claude-sonnet-5 为 75,441 个输入令牌等价量。

sents.en: We measure input-token-equivalent cost as input tokens + 1.25 × +\,1.25\times cache-write tokens + 0.1 × +\,0.1\times cache-read tokens.
sents.zh: 我们将输入令牌等价成本定义为：输入令牌 + 1.25 × +\,1.25\times 缓存写入令牌 + 0.1 × +\,0.1\times 缓存读取令牌。

sents.en: This measure excludes output tokens.
sents.zh: 该度量不包含输出令牌。

sents.en: One budget unit is the median call cost: 109,679 input-token equivalents for claude-haiku-4-5 and 75,441 for claude-sonnet-5 .
sents.zh: 一个预算单位即一次调用的中位数成本：claude-haiku-4-5 为 109,679 个输入令牌等价量，claude-sonnet-5 为 75,441 个输入令牌等价量。

paragraphs.en: To account for verification, we add v ∈ { 0 , 1 / 4 , 1 } v\in\{0,1/4,1\} budget units for each full-objective evaluation required by a protocol. This includes the initial evaluation and evaluations of individual proposals, unions, and candidates subject to an acceptance gate. The loss of a color candidate follows from additivity ( 9 ), so the direct evaluations used only to check that identity are excluded from protocol cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为了计入验证成本，我们为协议所需的每次完整目标函数评估增加 v ∈ { 0 , 1 / 4 , 1 } v\in\{0,1/4,1\} 个预算单位。 这包括初始评估以及对单个提案、并集和需经过接受门槛检验的候选对象的评估。 颜色候选对象的损失由可加性（ 9 ）得出，因此仅用于检验该恒等式的直接评估不计入协议成本。

sents.en: To account for verification, we add v ∈ { 0 , 1 / 4 , 1 } v\in\{0,1/4,1\} budget units for each full-objective evaluation required by a protocol.
sents.zh: 为了计入验证成本，我们为协议所需的每次完整目标函数评估增加 v ∈ { 0 , 1 / 4 , 1 } v\in\{0,1/4,1\} 个预算单位。

sents.zh: 颜色候选对象的损失由可加性（ 9 ）得出，因此仅用于检验该恒等式的直接评估不计入协议成本。

paragraphs.en: We reconstruct completion time from measured agent-call durations, assuming that calls in a parallel round start together. A round therefore contributes the duration of its slowest call, followed by an assumed latency t ver ∈ { 0 , 60 , 300 } t_{\mathrm{ver}}\in\{0,60,300\} seconds for each sequential verification step. Individual proposals are verified in parallel and together contribute one step; a subsequent union evaluation contributes another. The durations were recorded with up to 20 concurrent agents. Varying v v and t ver t_{\mathrm{ver}} shows how verification cost changes the comparison. Budget-success curves include every run, while median costs to solve are computed over successful runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据实测的智能体调用时长来重建完成时间，并假设并行轮次中的调用同时开始。 因此，一个轮次的耗时取决于其中最慢的调用，随后每个顺序验证步骤加上假设的时延 t ver ∈ { 0 , 60 , 300 } t_{\mathrm{ver}}\in\{0,60,300\} 秒。 各个提案并行验证，合计贡献一个步骤；随后的并集评估再贡献另一个步骤。 这些时长是在最多 20 个并发智能体的情况下记录的。 改变 v v 和 t ver t_{\mathrm{ver}} 可以展示验证成本如何改变这一比较结果。 预算-成功率曲线包含所有运行，而求解成本中位数则仅在成功的运行上计算。

sents.zh: 我们根据实测的智能体调用时长来重建完成时间，并假设并行轮次中的调用同时开始。

sents.zh: 改变 v v 和 t ver t_{\mathrm{ver}} 可以展示验证成本如何改变这一比较结果。

paragraphs.en: The tasks, agent instructions, protocols, stopping limits, cost measures, and planned analyses were fixed before the first main-experiment call. After observing nearly identical first-round behavior across the claude-haiku-4-5 replicates, we added a claude-sonnet-5 replication to examine whether the conflict pattern depended on the model. The tasks, protocols, and cost accounting were unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 任务、智能体指令、协议、停止上限、成本度量以及计划中的分析均在第一次主实验调用之前即已固定。 在观察到 claude-haiku-4-5 的各次重复实验第一轮行为几乎完全相同之后，我们增加了一次 claude-sonnet-5 的重复实验，以检验该冲突模式是否依赖于模型。 任务、协议和成本核算均未改变。

sents.en: The tasks, agent instructions, protocols, stopping limits, cost measures, and planned analyses were fixed before the first main-experiment call.
sents.zh: 任务、智能体指令、协议、停止上限、成本度量以及计划中的分析均在第一次主实验调用之前即已固定。

sents.en: After observing nearly identical first-round behavior across the claude-haiku-4-5 replicates, we added a claude-sonnet-5 replication to examine whether the conflict pattern depended on the model.
sents.zh: 在观察到 claude-haiku-4-5 的各次重复实验第一轮行为几乎完全相同之后，我们增加了一次 claude-sonnet-5 的重复实验，以检验该冲突模式是否依赖于模型。

paragraphs.en: Across the two models, both verified merge rules solve all 11 runs with diagnosed edit conflicts, while MA solves none and MAG solves one (Table 7 ). The following diagnostic identifies the ownership decisions that produce these differences.

sents.zh: 在两个模型上，两种经过验证的合并规则都能解决全部 11 次存在已诊断编辑冲突的运行，而 MA 一次都未能解决，MAG 只解决了一次（表 7）。

paragraphs.en: We diagnose an ownership conflict by testing the two adjacent proposals while using the reference implementation for all other modules. We classify the proposals as conflicting when each passes the interface check individually with the transformation absent from the adjacent module, but applying both proposals causes the check to fail. This diagnostic identified conflicts in 9 of the 18 claude-haiku-4-5 units on T1–T6: all replicates of T1 and T6, two of T3, and one of T5. claude-sonnet-5 produced conflicts in 2 of its 6 units, on T2 and T6. The models differed in how they assigned ownership: claude-haiku-4-5 double-applied the coupon, while claude-sonnet-5 double-escaped HTML. Across both models, every outcome difference among the parallel rules arose on a diagnosed conflict. All 108 audited color merges satisfied additivity ( 9 ) exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过测试两个相邻提案、同时对所有其他模块使用参考实现来诊断所有权冲突。 当每个提案在变换未应用于相邻模块的情况下都能单独通过接口检查、但同时应用两个提案会导致检查失败时，我们将这些提案归类为冲突。 这一诊断在 T1–T6 的 18 个 claude-haiku-4-5 单元中识别出 9 个存在冲突：T1 和 T6 的全部重复项、T3 的两个、以及 T5 的一个。claude-sonnet-5 在其 6 个单元中的 2 个产生了冲突，位于 T2 和 T6。 两个模型在所有权分配上有所不同：claude-haiku-4-5 重复应用了优惠券，而 claude-sonnet-5 对 HTML 进行了双重转义。 在两个模型中，并行规则之间的所有结果差异都发生在被诊断出的冲突上。 全部 108 次经审计的颜色合并都精确满足可加性（ 9 ）。

paragraphs.en: The first conflicted union lowers F F from 21 to 5 by repairing local defects despite applying the shared transformation twice. In the next round, both owners respond to the failing integration checks by removing their copy of the transformation. MA then alternates between both fixes and neither, yielding 21 , 5 , 5 , 5 21,5,5,5 . MAG accepts the first union but rejects the union of both removals because it does not lower F F . The verified rules evaluate the removals separately and select one owner, giving the OPT trajectory 21 , 5 , 0 21,5,0 . On T3, the conflicted union leaves five failures while the color candidate leaves four. OPT keeps a union when it improves more than the color candidate and can resolve any remaining interference in a later round. Table 11 gives all conflict trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Conflicts can also arise when edits are applied sequentially. In the claude-sonnet-5 run on T4, the records agent added quoting in the first pass, and the csvrow agent then quoted the fields again. The acceptance gate kept the second edit because its local repairs reduced F F despite the double quoting. In the second pass, the records agent removed its quoting and solved the task. The two claude-haiku-4-5 failures, T2 replicate 1 and C0 replicate 1, reached the pass cap with one hidden check still failing: name trimming and total precision, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 当按顺序应用编辑时，也可能出现冲突。 在 T4 上的 claude-sonnet-5 运行中，records 智能体在第一轮中添加了引号，随后 csvrow 智能体又对这些字段再次加了引号。 验收门保留了第二次编辑，因为它的局部修复尽管造成了双重加引号，仍降低了 F F。 在第二轮中，records 智能体移除了自己添加的引号并完成了任务。 两次 claude-haiku-4-5 失败，即 T2 replicate 1 和 C0 replicate 1，在达到轮次上限时仍各有一个隐藏检查未通过：分别是姓名去空格和总额精度。

paragraphs.en: The three-module benchmark contains programs that a single agent can repair readily. The scaling benchmark tests when concurrent repair offsets coordination overhead. Each task contains m m modules with five bugs per module. Function contracts specify ownership explicitly, and agents are instructed to rely on the contracts of other modules. Checks involve at most one base module and one composite module, yielding a nonempty bipartite dependency graph with χ f ​ ( G ) = χ ⁡ ( G ) = 2 \chi_{f}(G)=\chi(G)=2 . Each bug causes a visible check to fail both individually and alongside the other bugs in its module. Agents perform their assigned work without delegation.

Tasks with m = 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 m=4,8,16,32 contain 72–74, 144–146, 290, and 578 checks, respectively.

paragraphs.en: We introduce bugs by changing operators or constants in the syntax tree while preserving the surrounding source: swapping relational or arithmetic operators, exchanging logical conjunction and disjunction, changing an integer by ± 1 \pm 1 , exchanging minimum and maximum, or removing a negation. Each instance uses a separate bug seed. We retain a mutation only when the affected function’s visible check fails both with that mutation alone and with the module’s other mutations, and the program still terminates. Before running agents, we verified the initial failure counts, checked that the reference implementation passes every test, and traced the dependencies exercised by the checks. The base and composite modules form a proper two-coloring, and reference repairs have additive gains within each color class.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在语法树中更改运算符或常量、同时保留周围的源代码来引入缺陷：交换关系或算术运算符、交换逻辑与和逻辑或、将整数更改 ±1、交换最小值和最大值，或移除一个否定。 每个实例使用单独的缺陷种子。 只有当受影响函数的可见检查在单独应用该变异和与模块的其他变异一起应用时都失败，且程序仍然终止时，我们才保留该变异。 在运行智能体之前，我们验证了初始失败计数，检查参考实现是否通过每个测试，并追踪这些检查所执行的依赖关系。 基础模块和复合模块构成一个恰当的二染色，且参考修复在每个颜色类内具有可加的收益。

sents.zh: 只有当受影响函数的可见检查在单独应用该变异和与模块的其他变异一起应用时都失败，且程序仍然终止时，我们才保留该变异。

sents.en: Before running agents, we verified the initial failure counts, checked that the reference implementation passes every test, and traced the dependencies exercised by the checks.
sents.zh: 在运行智能体之前，我们验证了初始失败计数，检查参考实现是否通过每个测试，并追踪这些检查所执行的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: All 278 calls use claude-haiku-4-5 : 12 whole-program calls, 84 sequential module calls, and 182 parallel module calls. Agents receive separate workspaces and fresh contexts as in Appendix A . Module agents are instructed to repair their own functions according to the specification and assume that other modules satisfy their documented contracts, even when an integration check currently fails. The instructions therefore direct agents to repair their assigned module rather than compensate for defects in neighboring modules. The single agent can choose which modules to test.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 278 次调用均使用 claude-haiku-4-5：12 次整程序调用、84 次顺序模块调用和 182 次并行模块调用。 智能体像附录 A 中那样获得独立的工作区和全新的上下文。 模块智能体被指示根据规范修复自己的函数，并假设其他模块满足其已记录的契约，即使当前集成检查失败也是如此。 因此，指令引导智能体修复其被分配的模块，而不是去弥补相邻模块中的缺陷。 单个智能体可以选择测试哪些模块。

sents.en: All 278 calls use claude-haiku-4-5 : 12 whole-program calls, 84 sequential module calls, and 182 parallel module calls.
sents.zh: 所有 278 次调用均使用 claude-haiku-4-5：12 次整程序调用、84 次顺序模块调用和 182 次并行模块调用。

sents.en: Agents receive separate workspaces and fresh contexts as in Appendix A .
sents.zh: 智能体像附录 A 中那样获得独立的工作区和全新的上下文。

sents.zh: 因此，指令引导智能体修复其被分配的模块，而不是去弥补相邻模块中的缺陷。

sents.en: The single agent can choose which modules to test.
sents.zh: 单个智能体可以选择测试哪些模块。

paragraphs.en: The recorded calls used no additional agents and remained within their assigned workspaces and editable modules. We saved the single agent’s program every five seconds to measure repair progress.
paragraphs.zh: 所录制的调用未使用额外的智能体，并始终保持在分配给它们的工作区和可编辑模块内。 我们每五秒保存一次该智能体的程序，以衡量修复进度。

sents.en: The recorded calls used no additional agents and remained within their assigned workspaces and editable modules.
sents.zh: 所录制的调用未使用额外的智能体，并始终保持在分配给它们的工作区和可编辑模块内。

sents.en: We saved the single agent’s program every five seconds to measure repair progress.
sents.zh: 我们每五秒保存一次该智能体的程序，以衡量修复进度。

paragraphs.en: The protocols, iteration limits, input-cost measure, and time model follow Appendix A . We omitted SEQ at m = 32 m=32 because each pass requires 32 sequential calls and it was already the slowest protocol at m ≤ 16 m\leq 16 . Parallel rules share their first-round calls. In later rounds, they also share a call when they request the same module from an identical artifact. Each rule is charged for every call it uses. The median call cost was 123,539 input-token equivalents.
paragraphs.zh: 协议、迭代上限、输入成本度量与时间模型遵循附录 A。 我们在 m = 32 时省略了 SEQ，因为每一轮需要 32 次顺序调用，且它在 m ≤ 16 时已经是最慢的协议。 并行规则共享其第一轮的调用。 在后续轮次中，当它们从相同的制品请求同一模块时，也会共享调用。 每条规则都要为其使用的每次调用付费。 调用成本的中位数为 123,539 个输入 token 等价物。

sents.en: The protocols, iteration limits, input-cost measure, and time model follow Appendix A .
sents.zh: 协议、迭代上限、输入成本度量与时间模型遵循附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Calls were launched in batches of at most 20, while the time model assumes simultaneous starts within a round. To assess whether the worker limit would change the modeled duration, we scheduled the recorded calls on 20 workers in descending order of duration. Every round still finished within the duration of its slowest call. Thus the recorded calls fit within the assumed round duration on 20 workers. The modeled times omit queueing and orchestration delays.
paragraphs.zh: 调用以每批最多 20 个的方式启动，而时间模型假设同一轮内的调用是同时开始的。 为评估工作进程数量限制是否会改变建模的时长，我们按时长降序在 20 个工作进程上调度了记录的调用。 每一轮仍然都在其最慢调用的时长内完成。 因此，记录的调用在 20 个工作进程上符合假设的轮次时长。 建模的时间未计入排队和编排延迟。

sents.en: Calls were launched in batches of at most 20, while the time model assumes simultaneous starts within a round.
sents.zh: 调用以每批最多 20 个的方式启动，而时间模型假设同一轮内的调用是同时开始的。

sents.en: To assess whether the worker limit would change the modeled duration, we scheduled the recorded calls on 20 workers in descending order of duration.
sents.zh: 为评估工作进程数量限制是否会改变建模的时长，我们按时长降序在 20 个工作进程上调度了记录的调用。

sents.en: Every round still finished within the duration of its slowest call.
sents.zh: 每一轮仍然都在其最慢调用的时长内完成。

sents.en: Thus the recorded calls fit within the assumed round duration on 20 workers.

paragraphs.en: Every protocol passed all visible and hidden checks on every instance it ran. SGL completed each task in one session, and SEQ completed each in one pass. MA , MAG , and OPT usually finished in one round. Their exception was the third 16-module instance (S16c in Table 12 ), with trajectory 182 , 2 , 0 182,2,0 : the invoice agent left one function unrepaired, and the same two checks failed when its proposal was tested alone against the reference. COL completed repair after re-verifying its deferred class, as in the trajectory 386,153 , 0 386,153,0 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个协议在其运行的每个实例上都通过了所有可见和隐藏检查。 SGL 在一次会话中完成了每个任务，SEQ 在一遍中完成了每个任务。 MA、MAG 和 OPT 通常在一轮内完成。 它们的例外是第三个 16 模块实例（表 12 中的 S16c），轨迹为 182,2,0：发票智能体留下一个函数未修复，并且当其提案单独对参考实现测试时，同样的两个检查失败了。 COL 在重新验证其延迟类别后完成修复，如轨迹 386,153,0 所示。

sents.en: Every protocol passed all visible and hidden checks on every instance it ran.
sents.zh: 每个协议在其运行的每个实例上都通过了所有可见和隐藏检查。

sents.en: SGL completed each task in one session, and SEQ completed each in one pass.
sents.zh: SGL 在一次会话中完成了每个任务，SEQ 在一遍中完成了每个任务。

sents.en: MA , MAG , and OPT usually finished in one round.
sents.zh: MA、MAG 和 OPT 通常在一轮内完成。

sents.en: Their exception was the third 16-module instance (S16c in Table 12 ), with trajectory 182 , 2 , 0 182,2,0 : the invoice agent left one function unrepaired, and the same two checks failed when its proposal was tested alone against the reference.
sents.zh: 它们的例外是第三个 16 模块实例（表 12 中的 S16c），轨迹为 182,2,0：发票智能体留下一个函数未修复，并且当其提案单独对参考实现测试时，同样的两个检查失败了。

sents.en: COL completed repair after re-verifying its deferred class, as in the trajectory 386,153 , 0 386,153,0 .
sents.zh: COL 在重新验证其延迟类别后完成修复，如轨迹 386,153,0 所示。

paragraphs.en: All m m first-round proposals improved F F individually. Their union outperformed the color candidate on all 12 instances, leaving zero failures except for the two on that 16-module instance, compared with 19–156 failures for the color candidate. The positive interaction surplus ( 12 ) ranged from 5 to 36 checks: a check involving both a faulty base function and a faulty composite function passes only after both are repaired. Additivity ( 9 ) held in all 38 audited color merges, and OPT always selected the union over the verified color candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 m m 个第一轮提案均各自改进了 F F。 它们的并集在全部 12 个实例上都优于颜色候选，除该 16 模块实例上的两处失败外实现了零失败，而颜色候选有 19–156 次失败。 正交互盈余 ( 12 ) 介于 5 到 36 次检查之间：涉及故障基础函数和故障复合函数二者的检查只有在两者都被修复后才能通过。 可加性 ( 9 ) 在全部 38 次经审计的颜色合并中均成立，且 OPT 总是选择并集而非已验证的颜色候选。

sents.en: All m m first-round proposals improved F F individually.
sents.zh: 所有 m m 个第一轮提案均各自改进了 F F。

sents.en: Additivity ( 9 ) held in all 38 audited color merges, and OPT always selected the union over the verified color candidate.
sents.zh: 可加性 ( 9 ) 在全部 38 次经审计的颜色合并中均成立，且 OPT 总是选择并集而非已验证的颜色候选。

paragraphs.en: The timing results in Figure 7 reflect a balance between the single agent’s efficiency and the duration of the slowest parallel call. The single agent spent 26.5–43.0 seconds per module, with a geometric mean of 28.6 seconds at m = 32 m=32 , and ran tests 3–13 times per session. Parallel calls repaired only five bugs each but took a median of 97 seconds, used 16 tools, and consumed 128k input-token equivalents. Median call duration varied from 80 to 152 seconds across instances. Within a round, the slowest call took 1.45–3.5 times the median, setting the modeled agent time at 140–280 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 中的耗时结果反映了单个智能体的效率与最慢并行调用持续时间之间的平衡。 单个智能体每个模块花费 26.5–43.0 秒，在 m = 32 m=32 时几何平均值为 28.6 秒，每次会话运行测试 3–13 次。 并行调用每次仅修复五个错误，但中位耗时 97 秒，使用 16 个工具，消耗 128k 输入 token 等效量。 各实例的中位调用持续时间在 80 到 152 秒之间变化。 在一轮中，最慢的调用耗时为中位数的 1.45–3.5 倍，由此将建模的智能体时间设定为 140–280 秒。

sents.en: The timing results in Figure 7 reflect a balance between the single agent’s efficiency and the duration of the slowest parallel call.
sents.zh: 图 7 中的耗时结果反映了单个智能体的效率与最慢并行调用持续时间之间的平衡。

sents.en: The single agent spent 26.5–43.0 seconds per module, with a geometric mean of 28.6 seconds at m = 32 m=32 , and ran tests 3–13 times per session.
sents.zh: 单个智能体每个模块花费 26.5–43.0 秒，在 m = 32 m=32 时几何平均值为 28.6 秒，每次会话运行测试 3–13 次。

sents.en: Parallel calls repaired only five bugs each but took a median of 97 seconds, used 16 tools, and consumed 128k input-token equivalents.
sents.zh: 并行调用每次仅修复五个错误，但中位耗时 97 秒，使用 16 个工具，消耗 128k 输入 token 等效量。

sents.en: Median call duration varied from 80 to 152 seconds across instances.
sents.zh: 各实例的中位调用持续时间在 80 到 152 秒之间变化。

sents.en: Within a round, the slowest call took 1.45–3.5 times the median, setting the modeled agent time at 140–280 seconds.
sents.zh: 在一轮中，最慢的调用耗时为中位数的 1.45–3.5 倍，由此将建模的智能体时间设定为 140–280 秒。

paragraphs.en: As the number of modules grows, the single agent’s roughly linear repair time eventually exceeds this parallel-round duration. At t ver = 0 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=0 , the crossover occurs between m = 4 m=4 and m = 8 m=8 ; at t ver = 60 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=60 seconds, the speedup at m = 8 m=8 is only 1.04. Verification also separates the parallel rules: OPT evaluates individual proposals and then their union, while MA evaluates only the union. Consequently, MA has a shorter modeled completion time when verification latency is positive.
paragraphs.zh: 随着模块数量的增长，单个智能体大致线性的修复时间最终会超过这一并行轮次的时长。 在 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=0 时，交叉点出现在 m=4 与 m=8 之间；当 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=60 秒时，m=8 时的加速比仅为 1.04。 验证同样区分了这两种并行规则：OPT 会评估各个单独的提议，然后再评估它们的并集，而 MA 只评估并集。 因此，当验证时延为正时，MA 具有更短的建模完成时间。

sents.en: As the number of modules grows, the single agent’s roughly linear repair time eventually exceeds this parallel-round duration.
sents.zh: 随着模块数量的增长，单个智能体大致线性的修复时间最终会超过这一并行轮次的时长。

sents.en: At t ver = 0 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=0 , the crossover occurs between m = 4 m=4 and m = 8 m=8 ; at t ver = 60 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=60 seconds, the speedup at m = 8 m=8 is only 1.04.
sents.zh: 在 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=0 时，交叉点出现在 m=4 与 m=8 之间；当 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=60 秒时，m=8 时的加速比仅为 1.04。

sents.en: Verification also separates the parallel rules: OPT evaluates individual proposals and then their union, while MA evaluates only the union.
sents.zh: 验证同样区分了这两种并行规则：OPT 会评估各个单独的提议，然后再评估它们的并集，而 MA 只评估并集。

sents.en: Consequently, MA has a shorter modeled completion time when verification latency is positive.
sents.zh: 因此，当验证时延为正时，MA 具有更短的建模完成时间。

paragraphs.en: The time saving comes with greater input cost. The single agent’s peak context averaged 73k, 94k, 115k, and 122k tokens at m = 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 m=4,8,16,32 , compared with a median peak of 64k for parallel calls. Cache reuse keeps the single agent’s input-token-equivalent cost approximately linear over these sizes, whereas each module agent must read the task and program in a fresh context. The team therefore costs about twice as much at every tested size. Scaling beyond these instances will depend on the available concurrency and the growth of the maximum call duration.
paragraphs.zh: 节省时间伴随着更高的输入成本。 单智能体的峰值上下文在 m=4、8、16、32 时平均为 73k、94k、115k 和 122k token，而并行调用的峰值中位数为 64k。 缓存复用使单智能体的输入 token 等效成本在这些规模下大致保持线性，而每个模块智能体必须在全新的上下文中读取任务和程序。 因此，团队在所有测试规模下的成本约为两倍。 超越这些实例的扩展将取决于可用的并发度以及最大调用时长的增长。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 and Table 14 show how quickly repairs accumulate. At m = 32 m=32 , the modeled merge-on-finish team reaches 90% repaired 4.61 × \times sooner than the single agent, while the slowest call reduces the completion ratio to 3.61 × \times . These curves provide an optimistic reference by merging edits as they arrive and omitting verification. The executed OPT protocol waits for the round’s proposals and verifies them before merging, so its intermediate progress follows a different schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 和表 14 展示了修复累积的速度。 在 m = 32 m=32 时，建模的“完成即合并”团队比单智能体提前 4.61 × 倍达到 90% 修复率，而最慢调用会将完成率降低至 3.61 × 倍。 这些曲线通过在编辑到达时立即合并并省略验证，提供了一个乐观的参考基准。 实际执行的 OPT 协议会等待该轮的提案并在合并前进行验证，因此其中间进度遵循不同的时间安排。

paragraphs.en: Test runs here take seconds. To see how slow tests would shift the comparison, we added a modeled cost to every recorded test-runner invocation and kept each agent’s measured behavior fixed (Table 15 ). A module agent runs only the 9–18 visible checks that involve its module. The single agent ran all visible checks on every invocation in 10 of 12 instances. A cost per executed check therefore favors the team: at m = 32 m=32 and one second per check, OPT would be 7.41 × \times faster at t ver = 0 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=0 and 4.92 × \times at t ver = 60 t_{\mathrm{ver}}=60 seconds. A fixed cost per invocation favors the single agent, which invoked the runner about as often as each module agent. The projected ratios reflect both parallel repair and selective testing, with the recorded testing behavior held fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 此处的测试运行只需几秒钟。 为了观察缓慢的测试会如何改变比较结果，我们为每次记录的测试运行器调用添加了一个建模成本，并保持每个智能体的实测行为不变（表 15）。 模块智能体只运行与其模块相关的 9–18 个可见检查。 在 12 个实例中的 10 个里，单一智能体在每次调用时运行了所有可见检查。 因此，按每次执行的检查计费的成本对团队有利：在 m=32 且每次检查一秒的条件下，OPT 在 t_ver=0 时会快 7.41 倍，在 t_ver=60 秒时会快 4.92 倍。 按每次调用计费的固定成本则对单一智能体有利，因为它调用运行器的频率与每个模块智能体大致相同。 预测比率同时反映了并行修复和选择性测试，其中记录的测试行为保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark contains sixteen held-out interface-migration designs, eight with five modules on C 5 C_{5} and eight with ten modules on a prism graph. The designs vary whether interface ownership is shared or explicit and whether the initial program contains an additional local bug. The required transformations are non-idempotent: applying a transformation twice can introduce a failure even when either application alone is correct. Each design has three replicates, giving 48 task–replicate units grouped into sixteen designs. The objective counts failed visible and hidden checks, and we audit each check’s module dependencies against the declared graph.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试包含十六个保留的接口迁移设计，其中八个是在 C 5 C_{5} 上包含五个模块的设计，八个是在棱柱图上包含十个模块的设计。 这些设计在接口所有权是共享的还是显式的、以及初始程序是否包含一个额外的局部缺陷这两个方面有所不同。 所需的变换是非幂等的：即使单独应用某一次变换是正确的，将同一变换应用两次也可能引入失败。 每个设计有三个重复，共得到 48 个任务–重复单元，归入十六个设计。 目标函数统计可见与隐藏检查的失败数量，并且我们将每个检查的模块依赖关系与声明的图进行核对。

sents.zh: 目标函数统计可见与隐藏检查的失败数量，并且我们将每个检查的模块依赖关系与声明的图进行核对。

paragraphs.en: All methods use the same version of Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct . Module agents receive the specification, current program, and visible-check feedback, with edits restricted to their assigned module. The coordinator uses both visible and hidden checks to evaluate proposals. We compare MA , MAG , COL , and OPT with safe fractional integration ( FRAC ) and its optimistic variant ( FOPT ). FRAC selects the safe fractional-coloring candidate; FOPT also evaluates the full union and retains the better candidate. All six methods start from the same faulty program and reuse the same first-round proposals. Each method then requests proposals from its own accepted program, stopping at zero loss or after three rounds in total. This gives paired first-round comparisons and allows later proposals to adapt to each method’s repair trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法均使用相同版本的 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct。 模块智能体接收规范说明、当前程序以及可见检查反馈，其编辑范围仅限于各自负责的模块。 协调者同时使用可见检查和隐藏检查来评估各方案。 我们将 MA、MAG、COL 和 OPT 与安全分数集成方法（FRAC）及其乐观变体（FOPT）进行比较。 FRAC 选取安全分数着色候选方案；FOPT 还会评估完整并集并保留更优的候选方案。 全部六种方法都从同一个错误程序出发，并复用相同的第一轮方案。 随后，每种方法都基于其自身被接受的程序请求新方案，在损失降为零或总共进行三轮后停止。 这样可以得到配对的第一轮比较，并使后续方案能够适应各方法各自的修复轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 reports the final losses. FOPT leaves fewer failed checks than MA and MAG on all 48 units. The first-round fractional candidate improves on the full union in 47 units; FOPT selects the union in the remaining unit. All safe-candidate additivity audits pass. None of the six parallel methods reaches zero loss within three rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 表16报告了最终损失。 在全部48个单元上，FOPT的失败检查数量少于MA和MAG。 第一轮的分数候选在47个单元上优于完整并集；FOPT在其余单元中选择并集。 所有安全候选可加性审计均通过。 六种并行方法中没有一种能在三轮内达到零损失。

sents.zh: 表16报告了最终损失。

sents.en: FOPT leaves fewer failed checks than MA and MAG on all 48 units.
sents.zh: 在全部48个单元上，FOPT的失败检查数量少于MA和MAG。

sents.en: The first-round fractional candidate improves on the full union in 47 units; FOPT selects the union in the remaining unit.
sents.zh: 第一轮的分数候选在47个单元上优于完整并集；FOPT在其余单元中选择并集。

sents.en: All safe-candidate additivity audits pass.
sents.zh: 所有安全候选可加性审计均通过。

sents.en: None of the six parallel methods reaches zero loss within three rounds.
sents.zh: 六种并行方法中没有一种能在三轮内达到零损失。

paragraphs.en: The fractional candidate retains more gain than the ordinary-color candidate on 30 of the 48 shared first-round proposal sets. After later rounds, FRAC finishes with lower loss than COL in ten units, equal loss in 33, and higher loss in five. FOPT and FRAC finish with equal loss in 47 units, while FRAC achieves lower loss in one. Because later proposals are generated from different accepted programs, these final outcomes depend on the full repair trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 在48个共享的第一轮提案集合中，分数候选在30个上比普通颜色候选保留了更多增益。 在后续轮次之后，FRAC在十个单元中以低于COL的损失结束，在33个单元中损失相等，在五个单元中损失更高。 FOPT和FRAC在47个单元中以相等的损失结束，而FRAC在一个单元中取得了更低的损失。 由于后续提案是从不同的被接受程序生成的，这些最终结果取决于完整的修复轨迹。

sents.zh: 在48个共享的第一轮提案集合中，分数候选在30个上比普通颜色候选保留了更多增益。

sents.zh: 在后续轮次之后，FRAC在十个单元中以低于COL的损失结束，在33个单元中损失相等，在五个单元中损失更高。

sents.en: FOPT and FRAC finish with equal loss in 47 units, while FRAC achieves lower loss in one.
sents.zh: FOPT和FRAC在47个单元中以相等的损失结束，而FRAC在一个单元中取得了更低的损失。

sents.en: Because later proposals are generated from different accepted programs, these final outcomes depend on the full repair trajectory.
sents.zh: 由于后续提案是从不同的被接受程序生成的，这些最终结果取决于完整的修复轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Both controls use the same model, designs, and replicate assignments as the parallel methods. Each call starts with fresh context and receives the full current program and its aggregate loss. The one-module control, SGL , chooses one module to edit per call and retains the edit only when the loss decreases. It is allowed up to 3 ​ m 3m calls, where m m is the number of modules: 15 calls for C 5 C_{5} and 30 for the prism graph. Its mean final loss is 12.27, and it solves no unit. The same mean is reached when each run is truncated to the number of calls charged to FOPT .
paragraphs.zh: 两种对照均使用与并行方法相同的模型、设计和复制分配。 每次调用都以全新的上下文开始，并接收完整的当前程序及其聚合损失。 单模块对照 SGL 每次调用选择一个模块进行编辑，且仅当损失下降时才保留该编辑。 它最多允许 3m 次调用，其中 m 是模块的数量：C₅ 为 15 次调用，棱柱图为 30 次。 其平均最终损失为 12.27，且未解决任何单元。 当每次运行被截断至计入 FOPT 的调用次数时，会达到相同的平均值。

sents.en: Both controls use the same model, designs, and replicate assignments as the parallel methods.
sents.zh: 两种对照均使用与并行方法相同的模型、设计和复制分配。

sents.zh: 每次调用都以全新的上下文开始，并接收完整的当前程序及其聚合损失。

sents.zh: 它最多允许 3m 次调用，其中 m 是模块的数量：C₅ 为 15 次调用，棱柱图为 30 次。

sents.en: Its mean final loss is 12.27, and it solves no unit.
sents.zh: 其平均最终损失为 12.27，且未解决任何单元。

sents.en: The same mean is reached when each run is truncated to the number of calls charged to FOPT .
sents.zh: 当每次运行被截断至计入 FOPT 的调用次数时，会达到相同的平均值。

paragraphs.en: The multi-file control, SGL-MF , may return complete source for any subset of the named modules in each call. It also retains only improving edits and has a 3 ​ m 3m call limit, together with a token cap of twice the corresponding FOPT run. At the checkpoint matching FOPT ’s token use, its mean loss is 24.17 and exceeds FOPT ’s loss in all 48 units. At twice that token use, its mean loss is 20.52: it finishes below FOPT in four units, ties in three, and finishes above it in 41. It fully solves one unit. Across these runs, 130 calls produce outputs that cannot be parsed, limiting the control’s ability to apply its proposed repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 多文件控制版本 SGL-MF 可以在每次调用中返回任意命名模块子集的完整源代码。 它同样只保留有改进的编辑，并且有 3 ​ m 3m 次调用的限制，同时其 token 上限是对应 FOPT 运行的两倍。 在与 FOPT 的 token 用量相同的检查点处，其平均损失为 24.17，并且在全部 48 个单元中都高于 FOPT 的损失。 在两倍该 token 用量时，其平均损失为 20.52：它在四个单元中低于 FOPT，在三个单元中打平，并在 41 个单元中高于 FOPT。 它完整解决了一个单元。 在这些运行中，有 130 次调用产生的输出无法解析，限制了该控制应用其所提修复方案的能力。

sents.en: Across these runs, 130 calls produce outputs that cannot be parsed, limiting the control’s ability to apply its proposed repairs.
sents.zh: 在这些运行中，有 130 次调用产生的输出无法解析，限制了该控制应用其所提修复方案的能力。

paragraphs.en: MA uses a mean of 22.50 agent calls and 3.50 objective evaluations per unit, compared with 16.77 calls and 21.00 evaluations for FOPT . Each method is charged for the calls it uses, including calls shared with other methods. SGL-MF uses a mean of 96.62k total tokens, compared with 50.75k for FOPT . Matching call counts or token use leaves differences in context, evaluation cost, and edit permissions; the parsing failures further affect the multi-file comparison. The controls and parallel methods were executed separately, and shared calls prevent the combined parallel execution time from measuring each method’s latency. We therefore compare repair quality and charged resources on this benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: MA 平均每个单元使用 22.50 次智能体调用和 3.50 次目标函数评估，而 FOPT 为 16.77 次调用和 21.00 次评估。 每种方法都为其使用的调用计费，包括与其他方法共享的调用。 SGL-MF 平均使用 96.62k 总令牌，而 FOPT 为 50.75k。 匹配调用次数或令牌使用量仍会在上下文、评估成本和编辑权限方面存在差异；解析失败进一步影响了多文件比较。 对照方法和并行方法是分开执行的，且共享调用使得并行总执行时间无法衡量每种方法的延迟。 因此，我们在此基准上比较修复质量和所计费的资源。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate module-restricted repair on two historical multi-fault versions of Python repositories from BugsInPy-MF ( Callaghan and Fischer, 2025 ) : HTTPie version 2 and TheFuck version 2. The cases and public tests were selected before agent inference. Each case has three unseeded repeats, which are not three independent repository tasks. The model is gpt-6-sol through a tool-using CLI, rather than the Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct model used in the held-out interface benchmark. Agents can inspect source, edit allowed files, and run the published public tests. Agents receive neither reference patches nor hidden tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 BugsInPy-MF（Callaghan and Fischer, 2025）的两个历史多缺陷 Python 仓库版本上评估模块受限修复：HTTPie 版本 2 和 TheFuck 版本 2。 用例与公开测试在智能体推理之前即已选定。 每个用例进行三次不设种子的重复，这三次并非三个独立的仓库任务。 模型是通过使用工具的命令行界面运行的 gpt-6-sol，而非保留接口基准中使用的 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 模型。 智能体可以查看源代码、编辑允许修改的文件，并运行已公开的公开测试。 智能体既不会获得参考补丁，也不会获得隐藏测试。

sents.zh: 我们在 BugsInPy-MF（Callaghan and Fischer, 2025）的两个历史多缺陷 Python 仓库版本上评估模块受限修复：HTTPie 版本 2 和 TheFuck 版本 2。

sents.zh: 每个用例进行三次不设种子的重复，这三次并非三个独立的仓库任务。

sents.zh: 模型是通过使用工具的命令行界面运行的 gpt-6-sol，而非保留接口基准中使用的 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 模型。

sents.zh: 智能体可以查看源代码、编辑允许修改的文件，并运行已公开的公开测试。

sents.en: Agents receive neither reference patches nor hidden tests.
sents.zh: 智能体既不会获得参考补丁，也不会获得隐藏测试。

paragraphs.en: In the module-restricted condition, each invocation may edit one source module. Proposals from the same graph-independent block are generated against the same accepted source, and their union is kept only if it strictly improves the selected fail-to-pass tests while preserving the selected pass-to-pass tests. The global agent may edit any of the allowed source modules using the same model and public-test feedback. Its invocation limit equals the observed module-agent count for that repeat. It serves as a cost reference when one agent may edit all allowed modules. The graph is inferred from static imports, not certified against semantic interactions. Both graphs satisfy χ f ​ ( G ) = χ ⁡ ( G ) = 2 \chi_{f}(G)=\chi(G)=2 ; graph blocks were run sequentially, so neither a fractional-coloring nor an observed parallel-time advantage is tested here.
paragraphs.zh: 在模块受限条件下，每次调用可以编辑一个源模块。 来自同一图无关块的提案针对同一已接受的源代码生成，只有在严格改善所选的失败转通过测试同时保持所选的通过转通过测试时，其并集才会被保留。 全局智能体可以使用相同的模型和公开测试反馈编辑任何允许的源模块。 其调用上限等于该次重复中观察到的模块智能体数量。 当一个智能体可以编辑所有允许的模块时，它作为成本参考。 该图由静态导入推断得出，并未针对语义交互进行认证。 两个图均满足 χ f ​ ( G ) = χ ⁡ ( G ) = 2 \chi_{f}(G)=\chi(G)=2 ；图块是按顺序运行的，因此这里既未测试分数染色，也未测试观察到的并行时间优势。

paragraphs.en: The related public test files also passed in every final snapshot (HTTPie 26 / 26 26/26 , TheFuck 34 / 34 34/34 ), but these files are not whole-repository test suites. Across the six paired repeats, the module-restricted condition used 12 agent invocations, 799.8 seconds of summed agent wall time, 2,491,797 input tokens (278,933 uncached), 29,604 output tokens, and 105 agent-initiated test commands. The global condition used six invocations, 456.4 seconds, 1,470,456 input tokens (148,472 uncached), 17,759 output tokens, and 54 test commands. These runs demonstrate that module-restricted agents can pass the selected public tests in two real repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 相关的公开测试文件在每次最终快照中也都通过了（HTTPie 26 / 26 26/26，TheFuck 34 / 34 34/34），但这些文件并不是整个仓库的测试套件。 在六次成对重复中，模块受限条件使用了 12 次智能体调用、总计 799.8 秒的智能体墙钟时间、2,491,797 个输入 token（其中 278,933 个未缓存）、29,604 个输出 token，以及 105 条由智能体发起的测试命令。 全局条件使用了 6 次调用、456.4 秒、1,470,456 个输入 token（其中 148,472 个未缓存）、17,759 个输出 token，以及 54 条测试命令。 这些运行表明，模块受限的智能体可以在两个真实仓库中通过所选的公开测试。

paragraphs.en: The public SNAP roadNet-PA, roadNet-CA, and roadNet-TX networks ( SNAP, 2026 ) represent undirected road connections among intersections and endpoints. We evaluate proposal integration in 30 held-out regions, ten per network. Each region contains five connected blocks of 32 vertices, with the interblock roads forming a C 5 C_{5} dependency graph. Three initializations per region give 90 paired comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 公开的 SNAP roadNet-PA、roadNet-CA 和 roadNet-TX 网络（SNAP, 2026）表示路口与端点之间的无向道路连接。 我们在 30 个留出区域上评估提案整合，每个网络十个区域。 每个区域包含五个由 32 个顶点组成的连通块，块间道路构成 C 5 C_{5} 依赖图。 每个区域进行三次初始化，共得到 90 组配对比较。

sents.en: The public SNAP roadNet-PA, roadNet-CA, and roadNet-TX networks ( SNAP, 2026 ) represent undirected road connections among intersections and endpoints.
sents.zh: 公开的 SNAP roadNet-PA、roadNet-CA 和 roadNet-TX 网络（SNAP, 2026）表示路口与端点之间的无向道路连接。

sents.en: We evaluate proposal integration in 30 held-out regions, ten per network.
sents.zh: 我们在 30 个留出区域上评估提案整合，每个网络十个区域。

sents.en: Each region contains five connected blocks of 32 vertices, with the interblock roads forming a C 5 C_{5} dependency graph.
sents.zh: 每个区域包含五个由 32 个顶点组成的连通块，块间道路构成 C 5 C_{5} 依赖图。

sents.en: Three initializations per region give 90 paired comparisons.
sents.zh: 每个区域进行三次初始化，共得到 90 组配对比较。

paragraphs.en: Each road edge touching a selected block is one binary cut factor; edges outside the selected vertices contribute only constants. Each of five separate agents controls one block and attempts 30,000 within-block one-for-zero label swaps, preserving balance. A proposal is evaluated against a common incumbent; a nonpositive, invalid, or failed singleton is retained as null. After a development-only diagnostic, we froze a two-stage design before inspecting held-out outcomes. Stage one applies a guarded full union from the initial labels to create the same improved incumbent for every rule. This shared step gained 8,395 cut edges over the 90 units and is charged to every method. Stage two runs five new agents from that incumbent.
paragraphs.zh: 每条接触所选块的路径边都是一个二元切割因子；所选顶点之外的边只贡献常数。 五个独立的智能体各自控制一个块，并尝试 30,000 次保持平衡的块内一换零标签交换。 每个提议都会与共同的现有解进行比较；非正、无效或失败的单例会被保留为 null。 在仅用于开发的诊断之后，我们在检查保留集结果之前冻结了这一两阶段设计。 第一阶段从初始标签开始执行一次带保护的完全合并，为每条规则创建相同的改进现有解。 这一共享步骤在 90 个单元上总共获得 8,395 条切割边，并计入每种方法。 第二阶段从该现有解出发运行五个新的智能体。

sents.zh: 每条接触所选块的路径边都是一个二元切割因子；所选顶点之外的边只贡献常数。

sents.zh: 每个提议都会与共同的现有解进行比较；非正、无效或失败的单例会被保留为 null。

sents.en: After a development-only diagnostic, we froze a two-stage design before inspecting held-out outcomes.
sents.zh: 在仅用于开发的诊断之后，我们在检查保留集结果之前冻结了这一两阶段设计。

sents.en: Stage one applies a guarded full union from the initial labels to create the same improved incumbent for every rule.
sents.zh: 第一阶段从初始标签开始执行一次带保护的完全合并，为每条规则创建相同的改进现有解。

sents.en: This shared step gained 8,395 cut edges over the 90 units and is charged to every method.
sents.zh: 这一共享步骤在 90 个单元上总共获得 8,395 条切割边，并计入每种方法。

sents.en: Stage two runs five new agents from that incumbent.
sents.zh: 第二阶段从该现有解出发运行五个新的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Let g i ≥ 0 g_{i}\geq 0 be the verified singleton reduction in cut edges for block i i , and let S = ∑ i g i S=\sum_{i}g_{i} . The block conflict graph has an edge precisely when a road joins the blocks, so independent sets have no shared cut factors and their gains add exactly. COL selects the best pre-fixed class among { 0 , 2 } \{0,2\} , { 1 , 3 } \{1,3\} , and { 4 } \{4\} . FRAC selects the best of the five nonadjacent pairs supporting the optimal C 5 C_{5} fractional cover, each assigned weight 1 / 2 1/2 . MA applies all nonnull edits without a guard; MAG applies their union only if it improves the objective; FOPT takes the better of the fractional candidate and full union. The best singleton rule selects the highest-gain proposal. Adaptive ordinary coloring selects a coloring containing the best independent set after observing gains. These provide two further controls. Every rule scores the same stage-two proposal pool.
