paragraphs.en: When local-search agents share vehicle routes, exclusive route access limits which searches can run concurrently. We compare the duration of ordinary and fractional preemptible execution schedules under these conflicts. Both schedules use five agents solving a capacitated vehicle-routing problem (CVRP), with the same search budget for every agent.
paragraphs.zh: 当本地搜索智能体共享车辆路径时，对路径的独占访问限制了哪些搜索可以并发运行。 我们在这些冲突下比较了普通抢占式执行调度与分数抢占式执行调度的持续时间。 两种调度均使用五个智能体求解带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），且每个智能体的搜索预算相同。

sents.en: When local-search agents share vehicle routes, exclusive route access limits which searches can run concurrently.
sents.zh: 当本地搜索智能体共享车辆路径时，对路径的独占访问限制了哪些搜索可以并发运行。

sents.en: We compare the duration of ordinary and fractional preemptible execution schedules under these conflicts.
sents.zh: 我们在这些冲突下比较了普通抢占式执行调度与分数抢占式执行调度的持续时间。

sents.en: Both schedules use five agents solving a capacitated vehicle-routing problem (CVRP), with the same search budget for every agent.
sents.zh: 两种调度均使用五个智能体求解带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），且每个智能体的搜索预算相同。

paragraphs.en: We use four public CVRPLIB/DIMACS routing inputs ( CVRPLIB, 2026 ) : Loggi-n401-k23 and Loggi-n501-k24, and ORTEC-n242-k12 and ORTEC-n323-k21. Every schedule for an input starts from the same deterministic feasible Clarke–Wright incumbent. A fixed route-proximity rule selects a five-route cycle, and agent i i searches two consecutive routes of that cycle. Adjacent agents share a route and cannot hold their route-pair locks concurrently; nonadjacent agents have disjoint locks. This rule deliberately induces C 5 C_{5} rather than estimating a naturally occurring conflict graph. Each agent performs stateful stochastic two-route local search with a deterministic per-instance, per-repeat seed and exactly 500,000 candidate-move evaluations per schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用四个公开的 CVRPLIB/DIMACS 路由输入（CVRPLIB, 2026）：Loggi-n401-k23 和 Loggi-n501-k24，以及 ORTEC-n242-k12 和 ORTEC-n323-k21。 每个输入的每个调度都从同一个确定性的可行 Clarke–Wright 初始解出发。 一个固定的路由邻近规则选出一个五路由的环，智能体 i 在该环中搜索两条连续的路由。 相邻的智能体共享一条路由，无法同时持有它们的路由对锁；非相邻的智能体拥有互不相交的锁。 这条规则刻意诱导出 C 5 C_{5}，而不是估计自然产生的冲突图。 每个智能体执行带状态的随机双路由局部搜索，采用按实例、按重复设定的确定性种子，且每个调度恰好进行 500,000 次候选移动评估。

sents.en: We use four public CVRPLIB/DIMACS routing inputs ( CVRPLIB, 2026 ) : Loggi-n401-k23 and Loggi-n501-k24, and ORTEC-n242-k12 and ORTEC-n323-k21.
sents.zh: 我们使用四个公开的 CVRPLIB/DIMACS 路由输入（CVRPLIB, 2026）：Loggi-n401-k23 和 Loggi-n501-k24，以及 ORTEC-n242-k12 和 ORTEC-n323-k21。

sents.en: Every schedule for an input starts from the same deterministic feasible Clarke–Wright incumbent.
sents.zh: 每个输入的每个调度都从同一个确定性的可行 Clarke–Wright 初始解出发。

sents.en: A fixed route-proximity rule selects a five-route cycle, and agent i i searches two consecutive routes of that cycle.
sents.zh: 一个固定的路由邻近规则选出一个五路由的环，智能体 i 在该环中搜索两条连续的路由。

sents.en: Adjacent agents share a route and cannot hold their route-pair locks concurrently; nonadjacent agents have disjoint locks.
sents.zh: 相邻的智能体共享一条路由，无法同时持有它们的路由对锁；非相邻的智能体拥有互不相交的锁。

sents.en: This rule deliberately induces C 5 C_{5} rather than estimating a naturally occurring conflict graph.
sents.zh: 这条规则刻意诱导出 C 5 C_{5}，而不是估计自然产生的冲突图。

sents.en: Each agent performs stateful stochastic two-route local search with a deterministic per-instance, per-repeat seed and exactly 500,000 candidate-move evaluations per schedule.
sents.zh: 每个智能体执行带状态的随机双路由局部搜索，采用按实例、按重复设定的确定性种子，且每个调度恰好进行 500,000 次候选移动评估。

paragraphs.en: The ordinary schedule uses the fixed color classes { 0 , 2 } \{0,2\} , { 1 , 3 } \{1,3\} , and { 4 } \{4\} , assigning the full 500,000 evaluations to an agent on its one visit. The fractional schedule uses the five independent pairs { 0 , 2 } \{0,2\} , { 1 , 3 } \{1,3\} , { 2 , 4 } \{2,4\} , { 3 , 0 } \{3,0\} , and { 4 , 1 } \{4,1\} , assigning 250,000 evaluations per visit; every agent appears twice. Both therefore run the same per-agent search budget. The two compatible agents in a wave execute concurrently; waves execute sequentially. We measure elapsed wall time for the entire schedule, summed process CPU time, final route cost, and feasibility. Three paired repeats per input use the same initial incumbent and corresponding seeds, with schedule order reversed in the middle repeat. The nominal critical-path length is 2.5 2.5 rather than 3 3 full-budget waves, a 16.7 % 16.7\% difference before overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 普通调度使用固定的颜色类 {0,2}、{1,3} 和 {4}，在智能体唯一一次访问时将全部 500,000 次评估分配给它。 分数调度使用五个独立对 {0,2}、{1,3}、{2,4}、{3,0} 和 {4,1}，每次访问分配 250,000 次评估；每个智能体出现两次。 因此两者对每个智能体运行相同的搜索预算。 一个波次中的两个兼容智能体并发执行；波次按顺序执行。 我们测量整个调度所经过的墙上时间、进程 CPU 时间总和、最终路径成本以及可行性。 每个输入进行三次配对重复，使用相同的初始当前解和对应的种子，并在中间一次重复时颠倒调度顺序。 名义关键路径长度为 2.5 而非 3 个满预算波次，即在计入开销之前相差 16.7%。

sents.en: We measure elapsed wall time for the entire schedule, summed process CPU time, final route cost, and feasibility.
sents.zh: 我们测量整个调度所经过的墙上时间、进程 CPU 时间总和、最终路径成本以及可行性。

sents.en: Three paired repeats per input use the same initial incumbent and corresponding seeds, with schedule order reversed in the middle repeat.
sents.zh: 每个输入进行三次配对重复，使用相同的初始当前解和对应的种子，并在中间一次重复时颠倒调度顺序。

sents.en: The nominal critical-path length is 2.5 2.5 rather than 3 3 full-budget waves, a 16.7 % 16.7\% difference before overhead.
sents.zh: 名义关键路径长度为 2.5 而非 3 个满预算波次，即在计入开销之前相差 16.7%。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 shows faster fractional execution in all twelve paired runs. Paired wall-time reductions range from 13.16% to 17.28%, with a pooled median of 15.00%. The fractional/integral ratio of summed agent CPU time ranges from 0.991 to 1.027, with median 1.008, consistent with equal search budgets. Final route cost improves in four pairs, ties in five, and worsens in three.

sents.zh: 最终路径成本在四组配对中改善，五组持平，三组变差。

Uniform allocation assigns each agent to a distinct uniformly sampled block, so q i ​ b = 1 / 6 q_{ib}=\nicefrac{{1}}{{6}} . Optimized allocation solves ( 22 ) without a binding token constraint. paragraphs.en: Table 19 compares uniform and optimized allocation at each deadline using color-only costs. On this separable task, the union and color candidate coincide, so deduplicating them gives the same cost for optimistic integration. Each deadline is evaluated separately, without a shared total token budget across deadlines. paragraphs.en: Three AI agents independently repaired a parser, discounted-total calculator, and receipt formatter from one common faulty snapshot. Before the original calls we fixed 24 checks: 16 single-function checks and eight adjacent-stage checks. The block-dependency graph is the three-block path, with the two endpoint functions sharing a color. Agents saw the task specification and initial code, not the central checks or other proposals. We replayed the original frozen proposals and made three new calls to the same agents, which retained their earlier task context. The second batch therefore checks repeat behavior with that context available. Both batches gave the same results in Table 20 .
paragraphs.zh: 三个 AI 智能体从同一个共同的故障快照出发，分别独立修复了一个解析器、一个折扣总额计算器和一个收据格式化程序。 在原始调用之前，我们修复了 24 项检查：16 项单函数检查和八项相邻阶段检查。 块依赖图是一条由三个块组成的路径，其中两个端点函数共享同一种颜色。 智能体只能看到任务说明和初始代码，而看不到核心检查内容或其他提案。 我们重放了原始的冻结提案，并再次调用同样的三个智能体，这些智能体保留了它们之前的任务上下文。 因此，第二批检查是在该上下文可用的情况下检验重复行为。 两批实验在表 20 中给出了相同的结果。

paragraphs.en: The initial singleton gains were 7 , 4 , 4 7,4,4 . The best color class gained 11, while the union gained 23, giving an interaction surplus of eight. After the first color-class merge, re-evaluating the stored middle-block proposal raised its gain to 12 and completed the repair without another agent call. Optimistic integration completed repair in one merge, but both verified policies used five objective evaluations. Merge-all used two.
